description: Computer Equipment - capitalisable IT hardware at or above the capitalisation threshold (servers; laptops/workstations over threshold)
Furniture & Fixtures - capitalisable office furniture and fit-out
Prepaid Expenses - annual or multi-period prepayments covering more than 3 months (support contracts; insurance)
GST/HST Recoverable - input tax credits (ITC) on GST and HST paid
QST Recoverable - input tax refunds (ITR) on Quebec QST paid
Cost of Goods Sold - Materials - raw materials and components consumed in production
Freight Inbound - shipping and freight on purchased inventory/materials
Office Supplies - paper; toner; stationery; printer ink
IT Hardware - Non-Capital - monitors; keyboards; docking stations; cables; laptops below threshold
Software Subscriptions - SaaS and software licences expensed in the period
Cloud Hosting & Infrastructure - Azure/AWS consumption and hosting
Telecommunications - phone; mobile; internet
Professional Fees - Legal - external legal counsel
Professional Fees - Consulting - management and technical consulting; implementation services
Professional Fees - Audit & Accounting - audit; tax advisory; bookkeeping
Rent & Occupancy - office and warehouse rent; common area costs
Utilities - electricity; gas; water
Repairs & Maintenance - building and equipment repairs; HVAC; plumbing
Cleaning & Facilities Services - janitorial; waste removal; pest control
Travel - Airfare
Travel - Lodging - hotels and accommodation
Meals & Entertainment - business meals; catering; client entertainment
Marketing & Advertising - campaigns; printing of brochures; sponsorship
Training & Development - courses; conferences; certifications
Postage & Courier - outbound postage; delivery on non-inventory purchases
Miscellaneous Expense - use sparingly
